alignment_assertion: P[33] equals G2 prior row distal_contact_force_final_N at d>=1; P never uses current target force_next_max_N
coordinate_frame: global SOFA scene for xyz vectors; relative distal-node offsets to tip; SOFA scene length in mm and velocity in scene length per second
dtype: float32 after finite double-precision source checks
force_formula: G2 reconstruct_distal_contact_force using current Generic multiplier/Jacobian/collision geometry, 3mm tip region, vector sum before norm, divided by 0.006 s

indices.15:30: last five collision-node xyz velocities, same node order, flattened (scene mm/s)
indices.30:33: current distal contact-force vector from prior interval final substep (nominal N)
indices.33: current distal contact-force magnitude from prior interval final substep (nominal N)
indices.34: current distal contact-group count from prior interval final substep
indices.3:15: four preceding collision-node xyz positions minus tip position, ordered proximal-to-distal, flattened (mm)

normalization: per-representation input mean/std fit on TRAIN behavior rows only; shared exactly between suffix0 and suffix1; zero-std fallback 1
observation_instant: after previous control interval, before agent.act or candidate env.step(a_d)

omitted_features.all_SOFA_state: Not compact/interpretable and risks leakage or overfitting
omitted_features.contact_normal_set: Variable cardinality and topology; no deterministic compact summary audited
omitted_features.vessel_wall_proximity: No robust, audited fixed-dimensional triangle-distance extractor established in this phase

source: Generic CollisionDOFs and current Generic constraintForces at decision instant; no fork outcome
